title: Background-adapted covariant energy removes static flat-connection radius expenditure exactly

covariant_cancellation.operator: For fixed constant a define D_a=grad-i e a and H_a[phi]=(1/2)int(|partial_t phi|^2+|D_a phi|^2+m^2|phi|^2).
covariant_cancellation.fourier_diagonalization: On the torus, D_a sends Fourier mode k to i(k-ea); the mode frequency is omega_k(a)=sqrt(|k-ea|^2+m^2). Every mode solves an uncoupled oscillator and H_a is exactly conserved.
covariant_cancellation.charge_hierarchy: The global charge generator Q commutes with the fixed covariant operator. Hence the same conserved identity holds for Q^n phi at every charge tier, and every positive charge-analytic sum of the adapted tier energies is constant on its interval of finiteness.
covariant_cancellation.radius_consequence: The static flat mode consumes zero analytic radius in the background-adapted hierarchy even when generic holonomy prevents a periodic gauge removal. The |e|||A||_infinity contribution in raw B_A is therefore a Cauchy/absolute-value artifact on this sector.
covariant_cancellation.next_required_structure: A global nonlinear estimate must split harmonic flat connection from curvature-bearing and time-dependent modes, then prove integrability or cancellation only for the remainder while controlling the evolving holonomy separately.
covariant_cancellation.scope_guard: The exact cancellation is proved only for a fixed static flat background and linear charged matter. It does not control time-dependent harmonic electric modes, nonlinear current feedback, the radial term, or the full interacting flow.
